_doc: Template storyboard 10-frame cho VideoFlow Frame Bank. Mỗi 'frame' = 1 cảnh trong video 60s (~6s/frame). Bot sẽ gen 4 variants cho mỗi frame, anh pick variant ưng → tự động dùng làm reference cho frame kế. Edit blocks.setting + blocks.style + frames[*].action để custom theo project của anh. Sau khi paste vào Setup Wizard step 3, file này sẽ thành ./frames.json. Trong UI, anh có thể tiếp tục Edit Action từng frame và + New Frame ad-hoc.

blocks._doc: setting + style được prepend vào MỌI prompt. setting = bối cảnh chung không đổi. style = look-and-feel toàn video. action = phần riêng của từng frame (chỉnh được qua UI Edit Action).
blocks.setting: Modern eco resort 1000m2 in Vietnam, 5 bungalows with natural thatched roof arranged in a row, central swimming pool, organic vegetable garden with raised wooden beds, pickleball court, BBQ camping area with wooden tables, parking lot for 8 cars, surrounded by tropical trees and bamboo. Master plan layout consistent across all shots.
blocks.style: Photorealistic, cinematic 9:16 portrait, golden hour warm lighting, shallow depth of field, vibrant green and earth tones, high detail, captured by Sony A7IV with 35mm lens, professional architectural photography.

anchors._doc: (Optional) Anchor images = reference cứng cho 1 nhóm frame để giữ layout/character đồng nhất. Đặt file vào ./anchors/. Có thể attach manually qua UI '+ New Frame' upload.

master_plan.description: Sketch mặt bằng 1000m2 — giữ layout đồng nhất giữa các góc nhìn aerial

character_male.description: Model nam ~30 tuổi, áo polo trắng, quần short kaki — giữ outfit/face nhất quán cho cảnh có người

frames.action: Aerial drone shot from 80m above, showing the entire 1000m2 plot with all functional zones clearly visible (parking, 5 bungalows in a row, central pool, vegetable garden, pickleball court, BBQ camping area), golden hour, slight haze, surrounding palm trees framing the composition, faint top-down map perspective.
frames.video_take_prompt: Slow drone descent from high altitude revealing the resort, smooth cinematic motion.

frames.action: Eye-level shot at the entrance gate, looking down a stone path toward the parking lot with 8 spaces, wooden signage 'Welcome' and 'Chào mừng' visible, soft afternoon light, two cars already parked, lush bamboo on both sides of the path.
frames.video_take_prompt: Camera dollies forward through the gate down the path toward parking, slight handheld feel.

frames.action: Low-angle shot from the ground capturing all 5 bungalows in a perfect row, thatched roofs glowing under golden hour, wooden walls with warm light spilling from open windows, rocking chairs on each veranda, hammock between two posts on the nearest one.
frames.video_take_prompt: Lateral tracking shot moving past the 5 bungalows, parallax revealing depth between front + back rows.

frames.action: Wide shot at pool level, turquoise water with stone-tiled edges, sun loungers with white towels, an empty fresh coconut on a wooden side table at foreground, palm trees reflected on the water surface, soft afternoon light.
frames.video_take_prompt: Slow push-in toward the pool from poolside chair POV, water ripples gently.

frames.action: Close-up of organic vegetable garden with raised wooden beds, leafy greens (lettuce, basil, kale) sparkling with morning dew, hand of a gardener gently picking a cherry tomato, soft warm sunrise backlight, blurred bungalow row in background.
frames.video_take_prompt: Macro pull-back from tomato to wider garden context, rack focus shift.

frames.action: Action shot on the pickleball court, a young Vietnamese male player in white polo and khaki shorts mid-swing, paddle blurred, bright green court surface, white net, palm trees fence in background, warm midday light, dust particles caught in sunbeams.
frames.video_take_prompt: Slow-motion swing then snap to ball trajectory, sound of paddle impact.

frames.action: BBQ camping zone at twilight, the same young Vietnamese male in white polo grilling skewers, two friends seated around a wooden table with cold drinks, fire pit glow, string lights overhead, smoke curling up, warm orange-magenta sky.
frames.video_take_prompt: Push-in on the grill with sizzling meat then pull back to reveal friends laughing.

frames.action: Aerial drone shot at night from 80m, the entire resort glowing — bungalow windows golden, pool lit cyan from underwater LEDs, BBQ fire pit a warm orange dot, deep blue twilight sky with first stars, mist rising from the surrounding forest.
frames.video_take_prompt: Smooth aerial orbit around the resort revealing twinkling lights, cinematic music swell.

frames.action: Morning shot on the bungalow veranda, the young Vietnamese male in white polo holding a steaming Vietnamese coffee phin, looking out at misty mountains, hammock with crumpled blanket nearby, golden sunrise light through palm leaves casting striped shadows.
frames.video_take_prompt: Slow zoom-in on coffee steam then pan up to mountain view with lens flare.

frames.action: Interior shot of bungalow at golden hour, polished wooden floor, king-size bed with white linen and tropical-pattern throw pillow, large window opening to garden view with bamboo, ceiling fan slowly spinning, pendant rattan lamp, suitcase open with folded clothes hinting at arrival.
frames.video_take_prompt: Wide tracking shot from doorway to window framing the view, ending on a still composition.

transitions.prompt: Day to night cinematic transition over the resort, time-lapse.
